issues.title: Space and channel deletions leave the icon and attachment files in object storage
issues.body: When an admin deletes a space, its icon file is never deleted (the owner's delete path does delete it). And neither space deletion (owner or admin) nor channel deletion deletes the files of the message attachments that the database cascade removes, so those files stay in object storage until the orphan sweep finds them after its grace period, instead of being deleted with their rows. ### Details…

issues.title: Video and audio attachments are downloaded whole on render, with no playback fallback
issues.body: Every image, video and audio attachment is fetched in full, as a blob, as soon as its message renders. For video and audio that means the whole file (videos up to 12 MB) is downloaded into memory just by scrolling past it, which makes `preload="metadata"` pointless. A failed fetch is not logged, and a blob the browser cannot decode leaves dead player controls. ### Details - `apps/desktop/src/comp…

issues.title: E2E helpers call "localhost" but the API listens on IPv4 only; fails where localhost is ::1
issues.body: The API server listens on `0.0.0.0` (IPv4 only), while the Playwright config, the e2e helpers and a few specs address it as `http://localhost:3001`. Since Node 17, `localhost` resolves in the operating system's order, and on machines where that is `::1` first (typically Windows) the helper calls get `ECONNREFUSED`, unless `NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first` is set, which is documented now…
